title: Countdown timer
prompt: The robot's timer has time_left seconds to go. Return the time left after this frame, but never less than zero. With 0.2 s left and a 0.5 s frame, the answer is 0.0.
starter:
func countdown(time_left, delta) -> float:
	return time_left - delta

tests.name: 5 s minus a 0.5 s frame is 4.5
Stops at zero instead of going negative

hints: Subtract, then stop it going negative.
max() with zero keeps the larger of the two.

docs.name: max(a, b)
docs.what: Returns the larger of the two numbers.

solution:
func countdown(time_left, delta) -> float:
	return max(time_left - delta, 0.0)
